title: Anth.us Papyrus: confirm with Ryan — directory-style /articles/<slug>/ vs /articles/<slug>.html
description:
RESOLVED 2026-10-03 by Ryan: DIRECTORY-STYLE. His words: 'directory style, we already made that decision'.

Canonical URLs are directory-style:
  /articles/<slug>/   (NOT /articles/<slug>.html)
  /about/, /ai-solutions/, /ryan/, /platform/, /platform/<slug>/

This matches production anth.us, which is directory-style throughout (/about/ 200 and /about.html 301; /blog/<slug>/ 200 and bare /<slug>/ 200).

The namespace decision stands separately: /articles/ is canonical going forward, with 301 redirects from the legacy /blog/<slug>/ and bare /<slug>/ shapes for articles already published.

No blocker remains. PPY-d81a8c's implementation already assumed directory-style, so it is now CONFIRMED rather than provisional.
